question: How many sugar cubes are dissolved in a 2-litre bottle of Coca-Cola?
explainer: Classic Coke has 10.6 g of sugar per 100 ml, so 212 g in 2 litres. At 4 g a cube that is about 53 sugar cubes.

question: How many pizzas do Americans eat every second?
explainer: Americans get through about 3 billion pizzas a year. Divided by 31.6 million seconds, that is about 95 pizzas every second.

question: How many Olympic swimming pools would all the coffee the world drinks in one day fill?
source_title: How much coffee the world drinks (Tasting Table)
explainer: The world drinks about 2.25 billion cups a day. At 250 ml a cup that is 560 million litres, and a pool holds 2.5 million litres: about 230 pools.

question: How many Oreos are baked every second, worldwide?
explainer: Mondelez bakes about 40 billion Oreos a year in 18 countries. That works out to about 1,300 cookies every second.

question: If all the hot dogs Americans eat on the Fourth of July were laid end to end, how many kilometres would they stretch?
source_title: Hot dog consumption (National Hot Dog and Sausage Council)
explainer: Americans eat about 150 million hot dogs on the Fourth. At 15 cm each that is 22.5 million metres, about 23,000 km: more than halfway round the Earth.

question: How many litres of Coca-Cola products are drunk worldwide every second?
explainer: Coca-Cola serves about 2.2 billion drinks a day. At a 237 ml serving that is 521 million litres a day, about 6,000 litres every second.

question: How many grains of rice does the average person in Asia eat in a year?
explainer: People in rice-eating countries get through about 100 kg a year. A grain weighs about 25 mg, so 100,000 g ÷ 0.025 g is about 4 million grains.

question: How many Olympic swimming pools would all the tea Britain drinks in one day fill?
source_title: Tea loved by Brits (UK Tea & Infusions Association)
explainer: Brits drink about 100 million cups a day. At 250 ml each that is 25 million litres, which is 10 Olympic pools.

question: How many apples go into one litre of apple juice?
explainer: It takes about 1.5 kg of apples to press a litre of juice. A medium apple is about 180 g, so roughly 8 apples per litre.

question: How many bananas laid end to end would it take to reach from Paris to Berlin?
explainer: Paris to Berlin is about 878 km in a straight line, 878,000 m. A banana is about 18 cm long, so about 4.9 million bananas.

question: How many Olympic swimming pools of beer were drunk at Oktoberfest 2024?
source_title: Oktoberfest facts and figures (City of Munich)
explainer: Munich reported 7 million litres of beer served at Oktoberfest 2024. An Olympic pool holds 2.5 million litres, so about 2.8 pools.

question: How many bathtubs of milk do the world's cows produce every second?
explainer: The world produces about 930 million tonnes of milk a year, roughly 930 billion litres. That is 29,000 litres a second, about 98 bathtubs.

question: How many potatoes go into McDonald's fries worldwide in a year?
explainer: McDonald's buys about 3.4 billion pounds of potatoes a year, about 1.54 billion kg. At 170 g a potato, that is roughly 9 billion potatoes.

question: How many cups of coffee does the average Finn drink in a year?
explainer: Finns drink about 10 kg of roasted coffee each per year, the most in the world. At 8 g a cup that is about 1,250 cups: three and a half a day.

question: How many customers does McDonald's serve every second, worldwide?
explainer: McDonald's says it serves about 69 million customers a day. Divided by 86,400 seconds, that is about 800 people a second.

question: How many eggs do the world's hens lay every second?
explainer: The world produces about 1.6 trillion eggs a year. Divided by 31.6 million seconds, that is about 51,000 eggs a second.

question: How many eggs does the average American eat in an 80-year life?
explainer: Americans eat about 280 eggs a year each. Over 80 years that is about 22,000 eggs.

question: How many kilograms of chocolate does the average Swiss person eat in an 80-year life?
explainer: The Swiss eat about 11 kg of chocolate a year each, the most in the world. Over 80 years that is about 880 kg, nearly a tonne.

question: How many bananas does the world eat every second?
explainer: The world grows about 125 million tonnes of bananas a year, and a banana weighs about 120 g: a trillion bananas, about 33,000 every second.

question: How many pints of beer does the average Czech drink in a year?
source_title: Beer consumption in Czechia hits record low (Radio Prague)
explainer: Czechs drink about 128 litres of beer a year each, the most in the world. A pint is 0.568 litres, so about 225 pints.

question: How many kilograms of added sugar does the average American eat in a year, at 17 teaspoons a day?
explainer: 17 teaspoons of sugar is about 68 g a day. Over a year that is about 25 kg, a full suitcase of sugar.

question: Eating one apple a day, how many years would it take to eat a tonne of apples?
explainer: A tonne is a million grams and an apple about 180 g, so about 5,600 apples: a little over 15 years of an apple a day.

question: If all the meatballs IKEA serves in a year were lined up end to end, how many kilometres would they stretch?
source_title: Plenty of food for thought at IKEA (Ingka Group)
explainer: IKEA serves about a billion meatballs a year. At about 3 cm each that is 30 million metres, about 30,000 km: three-quarters of the way around the Earth.

question: How many Costco hot dogs are sold every minute?
source_title: Hot dogs and chickens by the millions (Anchorage Daily News)
explainer: Costco sells about 200 million of its $1.50 hot dogs a year. A year has 525,960 minutes, so about 380 a minute.

question: How many Starbucks coffees are poured every second, worldwide?
source_title: How many cups of coffee does Starbucks sell a day? (Coffee Explore)
explainer: Starbucks says it serves about 4 billion cups a year. Divided by 31.6 million seconds, that is about 130 cups a second.

question: How many Domino's pizzas are sold every second, worldwide?
explainer: Domino's sells more than 3 million pizzas a day. Divided by 86,400 seconds, that is about 35 pizzas a second.

question: How many M&M's are made every second in the United States?
explainer: Mars makes about 400 million M&M's a day in the US. Divided by 86,400 seconds, that is about 4,600 a second.
